name: IsaSubscriptionRecord
description: Tracks ISA subscription usage within a tax year. One record per customer per tax year per ISA type. Owned by SVC-001. Updated on every deposit to a Cash ISA account. Used for HMRC annual ISA return.

fields.name: isa_type
fields.description: ISA product type — currently only cash_isa supported

fields.name: tax_year
fields.description: Tax year in format YYYY/YYYY, e.g. 2026/2027

fields.name: tax_year_start
fields.description: 6 April of the tax year start

fields.name: subscription_used
fields.description: Total subscriptions made in this tax year — must not exceed annual_allowance

fields.name: void_flag
fields.description: True if HMRC has voided this ISA subscription (e.g. breach of ISA rules)

fields.name: national_insurance_number
fields.description: NI number for HMRC ISA return — must match HMRC record

fields.name: isa_declaration_confirmed
fields.description: Customer confirmed ISA declaration at application: 'I have not subscribed to another Cash ISA this tax year'

relationships.description: One IsaSubscriptionRecord per SavingsAccount per tax year
One customer may have IsaSubscriptionRecords in multiple tax years

design_decisions.decision: subscription_remaining is a computed field (annual_allowance - subscription_used) rather than a separately stored field.
design_decisions.rationale: Eliminates data inconsistency — if subscription_used is the source of truth, subscription_remaining should always be derived. This prevents race conditions between separate update operations.
